locations.name: Thompson Property
locations.description: The Thompson home and its fenced residential lot. The street is on the west; the backyard, pool and detached woodshop extend east behind the house. The concrete driveway approaches the attached garage from the west along the south side.
locations.modelMemory: Use the supplied property details as canon. No occupants, ages, schedules, decor style or family history are established by this map. Its plans are schematic: preserve stated dimensions without inventing a surveyed fit. Concealed items and spaces are not common knowledge; reveal them through the actual scene. Native parent/child navigation is broader than physical door-by-door movement.

locations.name: Lot
locations.description: An 80 ft wide by 140 ft deep lot with west street frontage. St. Augustine grass and foundation shrubs occupy the front; the driveway follows the south side. A 6 ft wood perimeter fence runs along the north, south and east boundaries. The house separates frontage from the backyard.
locations.modelMemory: For orientation only, the schematic interprets width as north-south frontage and depth as west-east. Exact setbacks and dimensions conflict in the supplied brief; do not narrate invented clearance measurements. The 8 ft north yard, 3 ft south yard and attached south garage are all retained as stated. No west perimeter fence or street connection beyond the property is invented.

locations.name: West Frontage
locations.description: The street-facing approach west of the Thompson house. The front lawn and foundation shrubs lie beside the concrete approach; the 18 ft driveway runs along the south side toward the west-facing garage bays. A 5 ft concrete walk branches from it to the covered stoop.

locations.name: Front Lawn
locations.description: St. Augustine grass fills the west-facing front lawn. Foundation shrubs edge the house, and the dining room west window overlooks this lawn. The street is west; the driveway and front-walk approach are to the south.

locations.name: Driveway
locations.description: An 18 ft concrete driveway runs in from the west street along the south lot line to the garage's two west-facing bays. Kyle's single-cab pickup is parked here. The front walk leads from the driveway to the covered stoop, and the formal living room west window looks onto the approach.
locations.modelMemory: Vehicle make, color, condition, parking direction and exact position are unspecified. Keep enough approach space in narration without asserting a scale-correct fit to the inconsistent lot plan.

locations.name: Kyle’s Single-Cab Pickup
locations.description: Kyle's single-cab pickup sits on the concrete driveway at the Thompson property, with the west street approach and west-facing garage bays nearby.
locations.modelMemory: This node represents being at or beside the truck; entering or driving requires the scene to establish access. Do not invent a make, model, color, load, keys or mechanical condition. Moving the vehicle is narrative state, not an automatic relocation of this map node.

locations.name: Front Walk
locations.description: A 5 ft concrete walk connects the south driveway to the covered stoop at the west front door. Foundation shrubs and the St. Augustine lawn flank the approach.

locations.name: North Side Yard
locations.description: An 8 ft strip of grass runs beside the north wall of the house, between the west frontage and the rear yard. The north gate is set in the fence even with the house's rear wall. Jennifer's north window overlooks this side yard.
locations.modelMemory: The fence segment containing the gate is not specified precisely. Treat the gate as the side-yard/backyard threshold at the rear-wall alignment, without inventing an off-property route through the north boundary.

locations.name: North Gate
locations.description: A gate in the north-side fencing stands even with the rear wall of the house, marking the route between the north side yard and rear lawn.
locations.modelMemory: Exact fence orientation, latch and lock are unspecified. The side-yard-to-backyard connection is an authoring assumption; no gate to a neighbor's property is created.

locations.name: South Side Yard
locations.description: The stated 3 ft south side yard is a narrow exterior strip beside the house and south-side improvements. An AC condenser stands on its pad here. The south wood fence defines the property boundary; access continues toward the rear south walkway.
locations.modelMemory: Its exact relationship to the 18 ft driveway and the attached 22 ft garage is unresolved in the source. Do not claim that this narrow strip accommodates either of those widths.

locations.name: AC Condenser Pad
locations.description: The outdoor AC condenser sits on a pad in the narrow south side yard beside the Thompson house. The unit and pad are exterior equipment, not an indoor utility room.
locations.modelMemory: Condenser make, size, service state and operation are unspecified. This node is the small working position beside the equipment.

locations.name: Perimeter Fence
locations.description: A 6 ft wood fence follows the north, south and east property boundaries. The street frontage is west; no west perimeter fence is specified. The separate 4 ft black aluminum pool fence encloses the pool area behind the house.
locations.modelMemory: This is an exterior boundary-inspection location, not a passage through the fence. Travel to the lot parent means returning to the grounds; it does not authorize crossing a boundary. No extra gates are invented.

locations.name: Thompson House
locations.description: A two-story home with west front entry, a stated 42 ft north-south by 36 ft east-west footprint on each floor, and a 22 by 22 ft garage attached south. All bedrooms are upstairs. The family room slider faces the east patio; laundry and garage service doors also reach that patio.
locations.modelMemory: First floor has no bedrooms. Preserve the stated footprint, attached-south garage and Jr's southwest room described as over the garage, while treating their vertical alignment as unresolved. House/floor nodes are scene overviews; narrate physical passage via doors and the stair rather than teleporting between rooms.

locations.name: West Elevation
locations.description: The street-facing side of the Thompson house includes the covered stoop and front door. West windows serve the dining room over the front lawn and formal living room over the driveway; upstairs west windows face the street, with Jr's also overlooking the driveway.
locations.modelMemory: Wall cladding, roof style, colors, door material and decorative details are not established. This exterior view is useful for arrival and sightline scenes.

locations.name: Covered Stoop

locations.name: First Floor
locations.description: The 42 ft north-south by 36 ft east-west first floor contains no bedrooms. The foyer is center-west, dining room northwest, formal living room southwest, family room east-center and kitchen southeast. The powder room is east of the foyer under the upper stair; laundry lies south of the kitchen.
locations.modelMemory: Use this as a circulation overview. Direct room connections not supplied are practical authoring assumptions and are identified in the source manifest. The east patio is reached through the family-room slider, laundry east door and garage east service door.

locations.name: Foyer

A coat closet occupies space under the stair, its door facing south; the stair rises along the foyer north wall toward a mid-landing and the upstairs hall.
locations.modelMemory: The powder room is east under the upper stair. Nearby formal living, dining and family-room connections are circulation assumptions, not measured door locations. The console is furniture, not a separate traversable room.

locations.name: Coat Closet

locations.modelMemory: Closet contents and dimensions are unspecified. Keep the sloping stair enclosure plausible without adding a second hidden passage.

locations.name: Main Stair

locations.modelMemory: Fourteen is the supplied total step count; no split between flights, turn direction, rail material or landing dimension is established. Use the stair for narrated changes of level even though native containment permits broader routes.

locations.name: Master Bedroom

Closed doors still limit sight and access narratively; a faulty lock does not make them permanently open. Do not assign occupants beyond the supplied room designation.

locations.name: Master Bathroom

Self-latching does not establish a keyed lock, alarm or automatic map state change. The enclosure may span the patio-side gap; its exact offsets are unspecified.

locations.modelMemory: Keep shallow north and deep south. Do not invent a diving board, ladder, stairs, cover, heater or water condition. This node represents the water or pool edge as established by the scene; ordinary map selection does not determine whether someone enters the water.

locations.modelMemory: The west door has no lock. Twenty-by-twenty-four orientation is unspecified; diagram dimensions are labels, not a surveyed footprint. Drawn curtains limit the east-window view; they do not imply another exit. Do not expose the concealed room from an exterior description.

The south-corner cabinet has a false back leading to a concealed private room. Keep the panel a discoverable physical feature rather than announcing its destination on arrival. No corner orientation beyond south is supplied. Its hidden link is on the South Corner Cabinet node and requires manual state change after the panel is opened in the scene.
